title: Johann Joachim von Sinzendorff, imperial ambassador at Constantinople, to Rudolf II, 3-7 September 1578: a despatch wholly in cipher (HHStA Türkei I 37-2, ff. 1-8)

documents.shelfmark: ÖStA HHStA StAbt Türkei I 37-2 (Korrespondenzen 09.1578-10.1578), fol. 1-8 (Láng 2015 C.Sin.03)

plaintext.source: Láng 2015 records no decipherment ('megfejtetlen'); none found online.

transcription.notes: No image of the despatch is online: the ÖStA Archivinformationssystem record for Türkei I 37-2 (ID 3855633, fol. 1-313) has no scans and no item-level entries; not on DECODE or HCPortal. 'cleartext_in_document: none' follows Láng's 'teljes' (wholly in cipher); eight folios per the shelfmark. Language German per Láng; not observed.

system.summary: Not seen. Candidate keys of the same series: Ungnad's (DECODE R392: monoalphabetic signs, German digraph signs, nomenclator) and Breuner's of 1575 (DECODE R1384: signs with vowel homophones, 15 double-letter signs, 8 nulls, Roman-numeral nomenclator).
system.notes: The ciphertext has not been seen; every system field is unknown. The two candidate keys are transcribed in ungnad1576/key_r392.txt and sinzendorff1578/key_r1384.txt.

prior_solution.where: No reading of the September 1578 despatch is known (Láng 2015: 'megfejtetlen'); Sinzendorff's and Breuner's joint despatches of March and May 1581 were deciphered at the time (Láng C.Sin.01-02, Türkei I 43-3 and 44-2), also not digitised.

conditions.human_role: Set the goal ('solve' catalogue 343). The DECODE session cookie on disk from earlier sessions was used to fetch key images. No images of the despatch supplied.
tools: DECODE key-transcription sweep (606 HHStA key records)
archive.org full text of Hammer-Purgstall GOR iv

solution.what: Read Láng 2015 repertory p. 252: C.Sin.03 = Türkei I 37 Konv. 2 ff. 1-8, 3-4 and 6-7 Sept 1578, German, undeciphered, wholly in cipher; siblings C.Sin.01-02 (1581, with Breuner) deciphered at the time.
Walked the ÖStA Archivinformationssystem: Türkei I 37 = ID 967789, files 37-1/37-2/37-3 (IDs 3855632-3855634), public, no scans, no item records.
Searched the DECODE list dump (10,106 records) for Türkei I, Sinzendorff, Breuner, Constantinople 1570-1590: no ciphertext of this correspondence.

Fetched and read the endorsements of the unnamed 1570s HHStA keys on DECODE: R1384 = 'Ciffra pro Dno Joanne Preyner, 1 May 1575' (Breuner's embassy to the Porte; transcribed in key_r1384.txt); R1382 Kobenzl 1576 (Poland), R1383 Manrique 1579, R1511 Polish-Prussian, R1515 Balassa, R1516 Schwendi; R1590 'Breuner?' is a 1749 code. No sheet endorsed for Sinzendorff.
Grepped Hammer-Purgstall GOR iv (1827) for Sinzendorf (13 hits) and searched the web in German, English and Hungarian for an edition or image of the September 1578 despatch: none.

Opened every sheet of Kt. 14 ff. 107-138 (R1374-R1391, the 1571-79 keys): Dornberg (Venice 1575), Rome, Italian, Polish keys, R1380 an Italian Ottoman-affairs key under Selim II (c. 1571-74), R1381 a German Ottoman-frontier fragment (A-B nomenclator, no endorsement), printed French forms of the 1590s. Then fetched DECODE's own transcriptions for 278 of the 286 records R1192-R1555 and grepped them: no key for Sinzendorff.

Full-text searched the ÖStA Archivinformationssystem across all fonds for a duplicate of the despatch (Sinzendorf 1578 / Konstantinopel / chiffriert / Ziffer): only Hofkammer financial files on his embassy's gifts and pay (FHKA SUS RA 315.1, 315.3, 276.29), no despatch, no scans.

outcome.method_basis: The 3-7 September 1578 despatch (HHStA Türkei I 37-2 ff. 1-8) is not digitised anywhere; only candidate keys of the same series (DECODE R392 Ungnad, R1384 Breuner 1575) were found and transcribed.

gaps.item: the whole despatch, Türkei I 37-2 ff. 1-8

outcome.notes: Blocked: no image of the despatch is online. Candidate keys R392 and R1384 are transcribed but untested. Next: HHStA reproductions of Türkei I 37-2 ff. 1-8, with 43-3 and 44-2 (1581, deciphered) as controls, ordered together with no. 342.
